name: plan-generosity-hoh1
about: Controlled Fury observations on the real imported HoH1 boss floors, with documented hoh1.content on/restart. Exact expected boss cohort and requested/predicted-pick/actual-held/cast-log IDs; actual-held movement, cost, cooldown, buffs and beams. Pre-active then later sampled suppression is separate from causal interruption, which is not proved by these RPC snapshots. Needs HoH1 import; kwargs only selects exact level names.

steps.name: hoh1.content on (off by default; saved with the town)
